column4: A copy of the oral hearing for KA0015

I would like to make a request under the FOI regulations for all/any information that ABP hold concerning the planning proposal for the new Brittas Windfarm wind energy project in the townlands of Brittas, Rossestown and Clobanna, near Thurles, Co. Tipperary. I wish to receive access to all information that Ørsted or their agents may have provided to ABP for planning purposes concerning this project.

1. A copy of any correspondence between ABP and its parent department with regard to its budget allocation in Budget 2024.2. A copy of any pre-budget submission prepared by ABP for use or submission ahead of Budget 2024.

All records held by An Bord Pleanála relating to 310685 and 310639 to include but not limited to all planning authority notices and reports issued, reports of sit visits on the 09/12/16 and the 05/12/18. appeal lodged against a section 15 Demand for Payment dated the 24th June 2019 including supporting documents/appendices submitted therewith;

All records in relation to Tirawley Wind Farm (315864), including most recent maps, powerpoint presentation and other materials provided by the promoter, minutes of meetings and everything currently on the file
GPS coordinates of each of the turbines proposed in the pre-planning application by Tirawley Wind Farm
A full disclosure of all details pertaining to the status of planning application reference number 23239 from Cavan county council.

1. A copy of the Inspector’s Report on the extinguishment and/or preservation of Rights of Way in relation to the interchange project 2. A copy of any reports in your possession discussing the impact of this project on public Rights of Way along that route 3. If possible, a copy of the public submissions related to this project (I am particularly seeking information on the destruction of the footbridge over the N4 which was completed as part of the interchange project)
Records submitted by AIRNAV Ireland relating to concerns they have outlined in relation to the Turbine application by Orsted recently.

Annual declaration of interest of each of the board members that considered this application to include the Inspector. Any decision in respect of the appointment of an Inspector or technical advisor to the Board. A copy of any inspector's report and/or technical advisor report in connection with the application. A copy of any notes, emails, memoranda and/or records between board members and between Board members and the Inspector/technical advisor. A copy of the presenting board member’s report to An Bord Pleanála on the application. A copy of any other documents that the board hold that may not ordinarily be on the Board’s file

I am seeking a copy of any information on file which records the reason for the ABP decision not to defend the above order, and in particular, any information on this file which provides ABP’s position on the principle of whether contributions are determined by the status of the first user or the developer.
